broker.name: Taurex
broker.tagline: Its site names 5 regulators, including FSA (Seychelles), FCA, and CMA. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:2000.
broker.about: The Taurex pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include Standard Zero, Pro Zero, and Raw. Platforms named there include Taurex Trading App (iOS and Android), MetaTrader 5, MetaTrader 4, and Copy trading (named on the homepage, no separate product name). The site names these regulators: FSA (Seychelles), FCA, CMA, BSL, and FSA (St Vincent). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:2000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.

broker.costs_note: Spreads and commissions move with the market, and they are not the same at every company in the group.

leverage.note: Homepage and the swap-free account table both say up to 1:2000 on Standard Zero, Pro Zero and Raw.
The fees page shows 1:1000, but the fetch did not show which account or market that figure belongs to.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: No single minimum. The swap-free comparison table prints conflicting figures in the same cells: Standard Zero shows both starting at $50 and starting at $0, with country exceptions; Pro Zero shows both $25 in select countries and $100; Raw shows $500. The fees page also shows $100 and 1:1000 without tying them to one account. The pricing page does not state a deposit minimum.

other_fees.label: Raw commission
other_fees.value: $3.0 per side on FX and XAU
other_fees.note: A separate pricing page says commissions as low as $2 per lot per side. The two pages do not match.

other_fees.label: Admin fee
other_fees.note: The site says admin fees depend on country of residence and instrument. No amount is published on the page.

_notes.fetch_notes: https://www.taurex.com returned HTTP 500 on 2026-10-11. Facts are from https://www.tradetaurex.com. The site says tradetaurex.com is owned and operated by the regulated Taurex companies, and that Taurex Global Limited is the issuer of the products on the site. The SVG entry is worded as registration with the FSA under 138 LLC 2019, not as a securities-dealer licence. Offices are also listed in Dubai and London. No founded year was found. The swap-free table prints two different deposit figures and two swap-free periods (10 days and 30 days) in the same cells.
